claims.claim: EAP can be for an unexpected crisis leaving the applicant without money for essentials.
claims.quote: be experiencing an unexpected crisis has resulted in you not having money to buy food, gas and/or electricity or other essential items

claims.claim: EAP requires the applicant to have no other money.
claims.quote: have no other money for example savings

claims.claim: IAP requires one of Income Support, income-based JSA, income-related ESA, Pension Credit Guarantee Credit or Universal Credit.
claims.quote: You must be getting one of the following: Income Support income based Jobseekers Allowance income related Employment and Support Allowance Guaranteed Credit element of Pension Credit Universal Credit

claims.claim: IAP can be for someone leaving an institution.
claims.quote: you are leaving a care home or institution (hospital, prison or foster carer) after 3 months (minimum) to live independently
claims.note: The claim omits the minimum three-month stay and independent-living condition.

claims.claim: IAP can be for someone avoiding admission to an institution.
claims.quote: you want to stay living in the community rather than having to go into an institution (hospital or care home)

claims.claim: IAP can be for setting up home after an unsettled way of life.
claims.quote: you are setting up home after an unsettled way of life

claims.claim: IAP can be for moving because of a relationship breakdown or domestic abuse.
claims.quote: you need to move home quickly due to a relationship breakdown or domestic violence
claims.note: The source requires a quick move and says domestic violence, while the claim says domestic abuse.

claims.claim: IAP can be for caring for a released prisoner.
claims.quote: you are going to care for a prisoner or young offender released on a temporary license
claims.note: The source limits this route to a prisoner or young offender released on a temporary licence.
